items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma with four assertions for the scheme theoretic image Z of a quasi-compact morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces: the kernel ideal I of O_Y -> f_*O_X is quasi-coherent, Z is the closed subspace it defines, the formation of Z commutes with etale base change, and |f|(|X|) is dense in |Z| (source lines 3249-3265). The work is in quasi-coherence of I: after reducing to an affine Y by etale locality, one takes an affine etale U -> X, notes that f_*O_X is a subsheaf of f'_*O_U for the composite f' : U -> Y, uses that f'_*O_U is quasi-coherent, and concludes that I is a kernel of quasi-coherent modules. Part (4) then follows from the ideal being the unit ideal away from the closure of the image.
